title: Orthonormality of multivariate Hermite functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\alpha,\beta:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb N$. The integral of the product of their multivariate normalized Hermite functions against the product standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$ is $1$ if $\alpha=\beta$, and $0$ otherwise.
